rules.title: Public network access must not be explicitly enabled
rules.remediation: Disable public network access and use an approved private endpoint and DNS path.

rules.title: TLS minimum must be 1.2 or later
rules.remediation: Set the service TLS minimum to 1.2 or later.

rules.title: Shared-key or local authentication must not be explicitly enabled
rules.remediation: Disable local/shared-key authentication and use a managed identity with least privilege.

rules.title: Purge protection must not be explicitly disabled
rules.remediation: Enable purge protection and document the retention and recovery procedure.
